items.title: A Natural Approach with Emma Ledwith and the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens
items.excerpt: Sheffield-based photographer Emma Ledwith created a series of portraits with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens and experimented in different environments. Emma talked to us about using this bokeh lens and how it influenced the mood and style of her shots.

items.title: In the Frame: Unconventional Portraits
items.excerpt: It's often the most candid shots that surprise us. While unplanned, they reveal plenty through body language and raw expressions. Our monthly photography prompt series calls on the Community to shoot and share their most unconventional portraits!
items.title_es: En el marco: Retratos no convencionales

items.title: A Day With Haruna Annaka: Precious Moments with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass
items.excerpt: 2026-09-22 #people![Image 3: A Day With Haruna Annaka: Precious Moments with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359171-a-day-with-money-haruka-annaka) Haruna Annaka is a Japan - China Friendship Ambassador and a model. But once she picks up a camera herself, she values capturing the unfiltered atmosphere of the moment. With the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass, she captured precious moments with her beloved Japanese spitz, Money.
items.title_es: Un día con Haruna Annaka: Momentos preciosos con el Lomo 'Instant Automat Glass

items.title: One Camera, Two Film Stocks: Julia Dimitrova Creates Memories with the LomoApparat
items.excerpt: Staying in your hometown as a photographer forces you to view familiar scenes through a fresh, creative lens. In this interview, Julia Dimitrova shares her reflections on spontaneity and nostalgia while testing the LomoApparat camera with Earl Grey B&W and LomoChrome Sunkissed ’92 film.

items.title: Reimagining Films on Film: The Devil Wears Prada
items.excerpt: Our special Writer's Notes edition is back with another reimagined film on film: The Devil Wears Prada. See results from Lomography writer @francinegaebriele's movie-inspired photoshoot and her personal reflection on the iconic franchise.

items.title: In Depth: A Brief History of the Disposable, then Reloadable, Camera
items.excerpt: Take a walk through the history of the disposable cameras, from one-photo wonders to reloadable and sustainable.

items.title: Collecting Characters in Vishnyakov's Found Photography Archive
items.excerpt: Lomography Community member Vishnyakov shares the story behind his archive, a refuge for found photographs and the forgotten characters they once belonged to.

items.title: Creators in Focus: Intersecting Material, Time, and Image; Peering Into Taras Perevarukha’s Photographic Process
items.excerpt: Ukrainian photographer Taras Perevarukha's works reside within the intersection of material and image. Being displaced by war in 2014 has bled its way through his lens’ perspective, turning his focus towards creating images that resonate themes of stillness, change, and transition.

items.title: Between Light, Shadow, and Emotion: Carl Cengiz Rakip Tests Lomography Films
items.excerpt: Fueled by curiosity, Carl Cengiz Rakip recently set out to try all of Lomography's film stocks. In this interview, he shares his insights and explains how analogue photography expands perspective on the world.

items.title: Coffee in Kent and a Photowalk in London with Elliot Masters and the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: 2026-09-16 #people![Image 11: Coffee in Kent and a Photowalk in London with Elliot Masters and the Lomo MC-A ](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359008-coffee-in-kent-and-a-photowalk-in-london-with-elliot-masters-and-the-lomo-mc-a) Teacher and freelance photographer Elliot Masters created a photo diary of this latest travels using the Lomo MC-A. He talked to us about his first experiences shooting with this 35 mm camera and what he chose to capture.

items.title: An Analogue Adventure in Egypt: Adrian Norbert Cuper Packs the Fisheye No. 2 & Sprocket Rocket
items.excerpt: The pyramids basked in sunlight, camels resting against the warm sand...Adrian Norbert Cuper knows how to capture these memorable sights with the Sprocket Rocket and Fisheye No. 2 cameras!

items.title: A Day With Taiwanese Breakdancer Quake: Getting Better and Learning to Appreciate One's Self More
items.excerpt: Breakdancing athlete Sun Chen, a.k.a. Quake, shares his daily life after the Paris Olympics, captured with the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass. He also opens up about the internal struggle between pushing the boundaries of his art and battling self-doubt.

items.title: Around the World in Analogue: Through Uzbekistan’s Historic Heartlands
items.excerpt: Come and explore the architecture and landscapes of Uzbekistan in this edition of Around the World in Analogue featuring photos from @sylours.

items.title: What Happened to My Photos? — A Beginner's Guide to Common Film Photography Mistakes
items.excerpt: Not sure what went wrong with your film? Learn to identify common film photography issues with this beginner's troubleshooting guide.

items.title: Chasing the Subtle Poetic Quality of Film: Taiwanese Photographer Jon Li with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: Professional photographer Jon Li tests the brand-new Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera, documenting his trip to Seoul, the captivating moments in his daily life, and the irreplaceable nostalgic quality of film.

items.title: The Places We Call Home: Ala Kheir on the Sudan Family Archives
items.excerpt: Ala Kheir shares how his project, Sudan Family Archives, keeps collective memory and legacy alive in times of loss and change. Preserving the photography of three families, the Archive offers a space to remember, relate to, and restore Sudan's heritage between past, present and future.

items.title: Decorating the Lomo'Instant Automat With My Colors: Artist BOM’s Custom Camera & Colorful Album of June Memories
items.excerpt: 2026-09-11 #people![Image 18: Decorating the Lomo'Instant Automat With My Colors: Artist BOM’s Custom Camera & Colorful Album of June Memories](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358990-lomo-instant-automat-bom-june-album) We handed artist BOM a white Lomo'Instant Automat and invited her to customize it. With her one-of-a-kind, colorful camera, decorated with her own stickers and 3D-printed keychains, BOM captured fun June memories to life in a vibrant photo album.

items.title: Falling for Half-Frame (Again) – A Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Review by @mackiechartres
items.excerpt: In this review, Community member and half-frame fan Patrick (@mackiechartres) takes us around Chartres and Paris, and talks about his first three rolls with the Half-Frame Simple Use Reloadable Camera. Will it dethrone his favorite half-frame camera, or carve a path of its own?

items.title: Harris Tomlinson-Spence Captures Nothing But Thieves on the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: 2026-09-10 #news![Image 20: Harris Tomlinson-Spence Captures Nothing But Thieves on the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359143-harris-tomlinson-spence-captures-band-nothing-but-thieves-on-the-half-frame-simple-use-reloadable-film-camera) We talk to Harris Tomlinson-Spence about shooting Nothing But Thieves with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera. The band's guitarist and songwriter, Joe Langridge-Brown, also joins to discuss their new album, Stray Dogs.

items.title: Film Soup Workshop Recap: Discovering the Magic of Experimental Photography with La Peliculera & Beatriz Tamarit
items.excerpt: Last June, we explored the experimental side of analogue photography alongside La Peliculera and photographer Beatriz Tamarit, through a Film Soup Workshop full of creativity and good vibes in the heart of Madrid.

items.title: Lomography Community Recap: August 2026
items.excerpt: Here’s your monthly dose of the latest happenings in the Lomography Community! Curious as to what your fellow Lomographers have been up to, or want the latest scoop on our ongoing Competitions? Find all this and more in our monthly recap!

items.title: Synesthesia Mixtape Vol. 5: Standing Between Two Worlds
items.excerpt: Following our Synesthesia series, we're inviting Community members to curate image-inspired playlists with Lomography. Our fifth album cover features the work of @bertietaylor.

items.title: Memory Visually Captured: Bineesh Viswam on Exploring Joseph Petzval Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lenses
items.excerpt: Bineesh Viswam, a Director of Photography from India, shares a documentary project inspired by the lives of Padma Shri award winners, framing their unique life stories with the signature look of Joseph Petzval Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lenses.

items.title: Collecting Everyday Sceneries: Hong Kong Artist Apple Wong and Her Analogue Visual Diary
items.excerpt: Hong Kong artist Apple Wong uses the Lomo’Instant Wide Glass to create a visual diary of her daily life and travels, combining instant photos, sketches, and paper collages to record everyday life.

items.title: Creators in Focus: Filmmaker Justin Kaminuma on Embracing Experimentation and Creative Instincts
items.excerpt: Our next Creators in Focus edition features Japanese-American visual artist Justin Kaminuma, exploring his experimental approach to filmmaking and discovering the inspirations that fuel his work.

items.title: 7 of the Best Smallest Film Cameras You Should Know About
items.excerpt: Sometimes, the biggest personalities come in the smallest packages. This saying rings truer for the pocket-sized powerhouses featured in today’s list of compact shooters.

items.title: From the Archives of The Family Museum: Historical Tintypes Collection
items.excerpt: Archival project The Family Museum (@the-family-museum) is dedicated to the legacy of photography and how it's been used across the decades. To celebrate joining the Lomography Community, co-founder Nigel Shephard elaborates on a collection of historical tintypes.

items.title: Asian Glow’s US Tour on the Half-Frame Lomourette & Sprocket Rocket
items.excerpt: With their raw sound and dreamlike melodies, South Korean musical act Asian Glow has carved out a world of their own. We follow their US tour through Lomographic photographs, exploring their musical inspirations and how film connects the past and present.

items.title: Quiet Moments on the Lomo MC-A with Ryan Kemp (theworldisanalog)
items.excerpt: Film photographer Ryan Kemp takes the Lomo MC-A on Pittsburgh walks, sharing his approach to moody photography, film, and everyday shooting.

items.title: Trail Running with the Half-Frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: Ding Yiqi's First Impressions
items.excerpt: A photowalk is common enough – but how about running and shooting? Lomography China handed the Half-Frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Classicolor to Ding Yiqi, inviting her to document a trail run in Hong Kong.
